Jamf Pro Server: Security Issues
Jamf provides the CVE-ID for security issues with high or critical severity when possible.
[PI209200] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2026-41715).
[PI214500] Fixed: A cross-site scripting (XSS) issue.
[PI228082] Fixed: A broken access control issue.
[PI230883] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2026-84939).
[PI209383] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2018-14040, CVE-2018-14041, CVE-2018-14042, CVE-2016-10735).
[PI232915] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2026-97687).
[PI232918] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2026-101896).
[PI232922] Fixed: A known vulnerability in a third-party library (CVE-2026-91777).
Jamf Pro Server
[PI-1577] Fixed: Inventory submissions may cause high database load when smart computer groups or advanced computer searches use patch reporting criteria.
[PI-1610] Fixed: The mobileDeviceEnrolled event may fail to generate a webhook when Apple TV devices are enrolled.
[PI-1613] Fixed: Adding devices to the scope of an in-house app with a manually edited version may cause the app to reinstall on devices that already have it.
[PI-1723] Fixed: On new installations, Jamf Pro may bypass the configured HTTP proxy and log errors when connecting to external services until Jamf Pro is restarted.
[PI-1961] Fixed: Renewing the MDM profile on Apple TV devices may return an HTTP 401 error.
[PI-1962] Fixed: Configuration profiles with Entrust SCEP dynamic challenges fail to deploy, and repeated "Error obtaining SCEP challenge from Entrust" messages appear in the logs.
[PI-1967] Fixed: Jamf Pro cannot create or renew the built-in certificate authority (CA) or its related certificates if the organization name is longer than 29 characters.
